name: D20 enhanced-Markov supervised-contact hybrid world model
status: frozen before trajectory replay or model fitting
purpose: test whether richer Markov observations plus explicitly supervised contact transitions repair the deployable world-model bottleneck while physical monitor v0 remains unchanged
scope: D3+D12 TRAIN folds only; joint validation, DEV, physical TEST and task labels remain closed unless every preceding gate passes

trajectory_collection.integrity: every replayed 61-D trajectory sample and every D17 start channel must reproduce exactly

model.type: action-conditioned graph dynamics with enhanced-state context and supervised four-way contact-transition modes

curves.requirements: improve physical separation-curve MSE and boundary/commitment sign agreement over frozen D2 on both primary TRAIN axes

monitor.requirements: improve frozen-v0 final decision agreement over D2 on both primary TRAIN axes before any DEV or TEST evaluation

stop_rules.one_step_failure: stop; richer observation plus supervised contact modes does not repair basic dynamics under this model
stop_rules.h8_failure: stop; compounding rollout error remains the bottleneck
stop_rules.curve_failure: stop; ordinary dynamics accuracy does not preserve local counterfactual geometry
stop_rules.monitor_pass: only then freeze a prospective DEV protocol
